title: Publish a Why Tactus page on Tactus-web
description: As an evaluator, I want a page that explains where Tactus fits against LangGraph and Hankweave and shows its production track record, so that I can choose it with confidence. Done when: the page is live on Tactus-web, leads with over a year in production, and includes one production example. Needs an example Ryan approves for public use.
